evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: We introduce a unified evaluation protocol along three axes (action expressiveness, scene invariance, and action-conditioned video generation quality) across robot manipulation, camera navigation, game, and driving benchmarks, most of which are unseen during adaptation.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Compared with annotation-free latent-action methods, our representations are substantially more expressive while matching their scene invariance, and they yield world models that transfer demonstrated actions to new scenes more faithfully.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: This has two limitations: learning the action space from scratch can limit generalization to unseen domains, and the bottleneck trades expressiveness for separation, with tighter settings losing nuance and looser ones risking scene leakage under domain shifts.
